rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial verb for kissing, including when the context makes it clear that two people are kissing each other.

example.english: When I see you, I can't help wanting to kiss you.
example.traditional: 見到你，我就忍唔住想錫你一啖。
example.jyutping: gin3 dou2 nei5 ngo5 zau6 jan2 m4 zyu6 soeng2 sek3 nei5 jat1 daam6

rows.note: Use 一啖錫 for an actual kiss as a countable noun; it is the all-purpose spoken choice.

example.jyutping: bei2 ngo5 jat1 daam6 sek3 sin1 laa1

rows.note: Use 嘴嘴 mainly in childish or playful speech for a kiss.

example.english: Come here, give Auntie a kiss.
example.jyutping: lai4 bei2 ji1 ji1 zeoi2 zeoi2
